author: Animan
description:
10 underrated anime masterpieces that deserved more attention! These hidden gem anime got overshadowed by bigger hits like Jujutsu Kaisen, Attack on Titan, Frieren, and Demon Slayer—and it's time to give them the recognition they deserve.

Some of the best anime ever made don't become massive hits. Sometimes, they release in the wrong season, compete with a viral anime, or get dismissed before viewers discover what makes them special.

Today, we're counting down 10 masterpiece anime that got buried by terrible timing. From mind-bending sci-fi and brutal revenge stories to heartbreaking tragedies and cozy fantasy worlds, these underrated anime deserve a place on your watchlist.
